summary: RMA Techniek designs and builds custom machines, mainly for the food industry, in its own workshop in 's Heer Arendskerke, Zeeland, Netherlands. For potatoes it makes sampling, tare and quality-assessment equipment, including camera-based defect analysers, 3D size sorters and dry matter analysers. It was founded in 2006.
machines: Defects sorteerder: AI camera sorter that classifies potatoes by defect, with optional ejection
Defect analyser: AI camera classification of potato sample defects on a roller conveyor
Internal Defects Analyser: automatic slicer and camera that detects internal potato defects
Hyperspectral analyser: measures dry matter content and distribution in potato slices
Optical size sorter: 3D camera measures potato length, width and height, ejects by spec
3D Camera hoge capaciteit: measures and sorts potatoes by size within a tare line
3D Camera Friet: measures length and height of french fries per sample
SolEye 3.0: manual classification of fries by frying colour, with data saving
Expert line tare lines: automated sampling and tare lines with cutter, fryer and 3D camera
Potato crate handling line: automated sampling, sizing, weighing and crate filling
facts: Founded in 2006 as a one-person business
Peeler/washers and underwater weighers listed in 15 kg and 25 kg batch sizes
Hyperspectral analyser development partly funded by the Province of Zeeland
